subject.title: feat(loop): implement autonomous agent loop (/loop) with token budget guard

question: Should OpenClaw add a standalone core `/loop` orchestration lifecycle, or should autonomous continuation extend `/goal` and existing task/plugin seams?
rationale: VISION.md discourages duplicated heavy orchestration, while the PR introduces a second objective, budget, state, tool, and persistence system; code review cannot choose that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Extend Canonical Goals
options.body: Keep `/goal` as the single session objective and budget state, adding only the smallest approved continuation seam through tasks, sub-agents, or plugins.

options.title: Sponsor Standalone Loop
options.body: Approve `/loop` as a distinct core product mode and require a redesigned implementation with canonical storage, surface parity, safety gates, and live proof.

options.title: Keep It External
options.body: Implement the orchestration as a maintained plugin or workflow package using current extension surfaces, adding a core API only if a concrete seam is missing.

recommendation.title: Extend Canonical Goals
recommendation.body: Keep `/goal` as the single session objective and budget state, adding only the smallest approved continuation seam through tasks, sub-agents, or plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The current goal lifecycle and continuance implementation are most directly associated with this person’s merged history, making them the strongest available owner for the overlapping product boundary.
